title: Mentor mapping, day-one rituals, and interview scorecard
content:
Purpose

This is a working doc for a repeatable mentor-mapping process paired with a concise Day‑One ritual checklist and an interviewer scorecard that balances skill signal + culture fit. Target audience: hiring managers, interviewers, recruiters, and assigned mentors. Want something light-weight that plugs into our existing thread of onboarding playbooks but focuses on early human connection (first 72 hrs) and better signal from interviews.

Top-level goals
- Reduce new hire cognitive load on day one; make the mentor relationship explicit in calendar + task list.
- Ensure interview scores map to decisions (avoid inflated 5s, normalize across interviewers).
- Provide a simple, repeatable interviewer debrief template that highlights risk signals vs. evidence.

Quick summary of flow (operational)
1) Prior to offer acceptance (recruiter): propose mentor pool (2 names) and a 1-week contact plan.
2) On offer accepted (people ops): send mentor intro + short "what I can help you with" questionnaire to mentee and mentor.
3) Day 0 (IT/People ops): ensure accesses, laptop, Slack, calendar invites for mentor 1:1s (Day1 30m, Day3 30m, Day7 30m), and cross-functional 15m intros.
4) Week 0 plan (mentor): 3 concrete wins — access verification, run first small task together, map 30/60/90 signals.

Mentor mapping matrix (practical heuristics)
- Primary mentor (technical owner): same subteam, ideally not manager, + 1 year seniority.
- Buddy (orientation): a peer-level engineer/IC who can help with day-to-day ops and culture.
- Secondary mentor (career/role): product or program-adjacent mentor with broader context.
- Rotate mentor: aim to change who the mentee shadows for exposure by week 4.

Day-One ritual checklist (to reduce friction)
- Pre-checked: laptop imaged, MDM enrolled, VPN + KMS access verified.
- Slack: company-wide intro + team channel pinned message.
- Calendar: 30m mentor meet (intro + expectations), 30m manager 1:1, 15m onboarding ops check.
- First task: clone repo and run a hello-world integration. Mentor helps with first PR.
- Comfort check: explicit 10m at lunch to talk role fit, bias concerns, and immediate blockers.

Interviewer scorecard (compact, to be used in debrief)
- Tech signal (40%): evidence-based assessment of core skills required for the role. Scores 1–5 but use only 2–5 for active candidates.
- Execution signal (25%): ability to break down tasks, debugging approach, tradeoffs.
- Collaboration & Communication (20%): clarity, candor, cross-functional empathy.
- Learning mindset & feedback (10%): how quickly they incorporate hints.
- Risk / note (5%): any red flags (passport, relocation, severe unknowns).

Interviewer debrief template (copy/paste)
- Candidate: <name> | role | loop date
- Quick verdict (hire/weak-hire/no-hire) – one line
- 3 pieces of evidence that support the verdict (linked to timestamps or question IDs)
- 2 open questions (things we need to validate in followups)
- Calibration note: did I coach the candidate accidentally? Any hints given?

Score normalization guidance (practical)
- Avoid top-box inflation: assume the average interviewer in a calibrated pool will center at ~3.3 for shortlisted candidates.
- When a candidate gets all 5s across panel: sanity-check against concrete evidence (deliverables or production impact). If evidence is vague, downgrade to 4 and record why.
- Simple adjustment rule: if an interviewer consistently averages >4.4 across 10 interviews, subtract 0.4 from their future numeric scores until re-calibrated via panel review.

People Ops TODOs (for this doc to become productized)
- Create short onboarding email templates (Mentor intro + expectations).
- Add one-click calendar invite templates for Mentor 30m slots and manager 1:1.
- Add score normalization badge in the interviewer UI (flag high-avg raters).

Notes to self / unresolved questions
- Should mentor be paid a token stipend for time spent in first 30 days? (benchmark: $200). Need finance approval.
- How many mentors can own a mentee concurrently? limit to 2 primary contacts; keep secondary pool opt-in.
- Can we automate mentor assignment using skill-tags from Greenhouse? low priority but would scale.

Appendix: quick message snippets (copy/paste)
- Mentor intro (to mentee): "Hi <name>, congrats and welcome. I’m <mentor>, your buddy for the first month. I’ll help you get up to speed on dev flow, review your first PR, and be a safe person for questions. Meeting invite: Day 1 - 30m. Looking forward!"
- Interviewer debrief prompt (Slack): "Defer to the scorecard: paste 1-line verdict + 3 supporting facts. If you’re unsure, mark as 'follow-up needed' and suggest a technical exercise."

Version history
- 2025-11-03: initial draft (Aisha)
- 2025-12-10: added score-normalization heuristics (Marco)
- 2026-01-15: Day-one checklist tightened; added calendar templates (Priya)

End of doc.

(Working doc — please comment inline or add a short reaction in Slack #people-ops-hiring when you make edits)
